title: USACE Critical Infrastructure Cybersecurity Modular SCIF
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.US ARMY CORPS OF ENGINEERS.ENGINEER DIVISION SOUTHWESTERN.ENDIST LITTLE ROCK.W076 ENDIST LITTLE ROCK
detail_text: The Little Rock District Corps of Engineers are looking for vendors that have a 350 - 400 Square Foot Modular SCIF readily available in support of USACE Critical Infrastructure Cybersecurity Mandatory Center of Expertise in Branson, MO. If you have one readily available, please send the specs of the building to Marcus Mitchell. Also provide the lead time it will take to have the building on site. My email address is marcus.d.mitchell@usace.army.mil My telephone number is 5013401253.
